summary: Iteration 6 backend regression covering new SafeTap features. Executed 24 pytest cases against https://threat-verify-7.preview.emergentagent.com — 100% pass. Verified role-based auth (victim/investigator/admin + wrong-role 401), URL scan flags `microsoft-login-alert.net/verify` as known/reported phishing, screenshot scan returns risk_score/factors/ocr_text/detected_brands/image_fingerprint/ai_explanation and second identical upload reports reupload:true, social scan extracts URL + detects KYC scam language (risk >=55), reports/mine scoping (victim = own only, investigator sees all), reports/{id} returns full evidence and enforces 403 cross-owner access + 404 for missing, assistant/languages returns exactly 10 Indian languages, assistant/transcribe accepts silent WAV base64, assistant/reply returns text and populated audio_base64 for both English and Hindi, /api/graph returns {nodes, edges, case_count} and admin count >= victim count, victim blocked (403) from /api/cases, /api/investigator/overview, /api/admin/overview, investigator overview exposes screenshot_cases + social_cases, admin overview exposes languages_supported (10 languages including English and Hindi).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses OpenAI models 'gpt-5.4' and 'gpt-4o' via emergentintegrations; live LLM path was exercised — no failures observed during this run. If the key ever fails, the code correctly falls back to deterministic explanations (labeled).
ACTIVE_TOKENS is an in-memory dict, so sessions do not survive a backend restart. Acceptable for demo, not for production.
/api/scan/screenshot uploads store raw fingerprint but not the image bytes — good for privacy; documented for main agent.
seed_data_creation: Test cases created several MongoDB `cases` documents via /api/scan, /api/scan/screenshot, /api/scan/social under victim and investigator ownership. No teardown required for demo workspace.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new endpoints (screenshot, social, reports mine/detail, assistant transcribe/reply/languages, graph) plus role isolation on privileged routes are green. Voice STT/TTS via emergentintegrations executed against live key. If future iteration removes EMERGENT_LLM_KEY, transcribe still returns 200 (empty text with error field) — that is by design; add a stricter test only if product contract changes.
